description:
List notes newest first, filtered by folder, tag or date. This is the tool for "what is new" and "what changed lately": search_notes ranks by relevance and never by recency.

created_* is when a note was made, updated_* when its own text last changed — a rename elsewhere rewriting a [[link]] inside it does not count as an edit here. Each row carries content_length, so you can tell a long note from a short one before spending a get_note call. With trashed:true the other filters are ignored.

created_after.description: ISO timestamp — only notes created at or after this

created_before.description: ISO timestamp — only notes created at or before this

folder_id.description: Filter by folder UUID — that folder itself, not its subfolders

folder_path.description: Same filter by path (e.g. "Projects/Kybase") instead of UUID — that folder itself, not its subfolders

limit.description: Maximum notes to return per page. Applies in trashed mode too

offset.description: Skip this many notes — pass back next_offset from the previous page

trashed.description: List soft-deleted notes instead of live ones

updated_after.description: ISO timestamp — only notes whose own content actually changed at or after this

updated_before.description: ISO timestamp — only notes whose own content actually changed at or before this

name: list_notes
